offending_extra_words: pay amounts due under this Agreement is not damages
reasons: Operation 1 is well targeted and completes the preferred cap: greater-of limb (a) fees paid or payable under this Agreement in the 12 months preceding the claim and limb (b) USD 1,000,000, with mutuality and the exclusion of indirect damages untouched.
All preferred carve-outs (confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, other party's IP) were already present and were left intact.

Operation 2 was unnecessary for the locked level: the original 21.3 already provided that Customer's payment obligation is not damages, so the preferred element was satisfied before the edit; rewriting the sentence exceeds the minimum change needed.

Operation 2 also removes the customer-favourable qualifiers "undisputed" and "for conforming Services", so disputed or non-conforming-service amounts now sit outside the cap against Customer — a weakening of an untouched protection and inconsistent with Customer's dispute rights.

Note (not a deviation): the defined term "Fees" (1.5/1.6) remains limited to the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee; the cap now uses lowercase "fees ... under this Agreement", which is intended, but the residual defined term is now unused in 21.1.
